utfall: grein 5: ikke-kognitive ferdigheter (praktisk-estetiske fag ved 16 år) betyr mer enn kognitive for NEET og trygd ved 22 år, motsatt for overgang til høyere utdanning (ingen tall i sammendraget)
sitat: However, we find that “non-cognitive” skills has a much larger impact than “cognitive” skills on the probability to receive welfare benefits or being inactive (NEET) at age 22, while the findings are the opposite for the probability of college enrollment.
